theorems.statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [HopfAlgebra k A] {H : Type*} [CommRing H] [HopfAlgebra k H] (ι : BialgHom k A H), ∃ θ : TensorProduct k A H ≃ₐ[k] TensorProduct k A H, ∀ (a : A) (h : H), θ (TensorProduct.tmul k a h) = (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : A →ₗ[k] A) ι.toLinearMap) (Coalgebra.comul (R := k) a) * TensorProduct.tmul k (1 : A) h
